title: Distance Between Two Places | How Far Is It - MapTools.co
content: # Distance Between Two Places – How Far Is It? Calculate the straight-line distance between any two locations in miles and kilometers. ## How Far Is It Between Two Places? Need to know the distance between two cities, towns, or ZIP codes? Just type in two place names and get the straight-line distance in miles, kilometers, and nautical miles. This tool calculates the "as the crow flies" distance - the shortest path between two points on Earth. It's perfect for getting a quick sense of how far apart two places are, whether you're planning travel, answering a trivia question, or just curious. ### Straight-Line Distance. The distance shown is the straight-line distance (also called "as the crow flies" or great-circle distance). This is the shortest possible distance between two points on Earth's surface, accounting for the planet's curvature. #### How far is New York from Los Angeles? The straight-line distance from New York to Los Angeles is approximately 2,451 miles (3,944 km).
